title: Running a 28.9M parameter LLM on an $8 microcontroller
summary: A developer demonstrates running a compact 28.9 million parameter language model on an ESP32 microcontroller costing just $8, pushing the boundaries of edge AI by enabling LLM inference on extremely resource-constrained hardware with limited RAM and processing power.
problem_solved: Enables running AI language models directly on cheap microcontrollers without cloud connectivity, reducing latency and privacy concerns.
why_valuable: Demonstrates that AI can run locally on extremely cheap, low-power devices, enabling new categories of smart IoT products with privacy-preserving, offline AI capabilities.
